extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: The canary + hardened prompt
note: **A unique secret planted in the system prompt, which also pre-refuses the classic leak tricks.**
- The canary must never appear in a normal reply; guard_canary watches for it
- Hardening is prevention; the canary check (below) is detection

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: Input policies
note: **The three rules the input guards check: jailbreak regexes, a topic allowlist, a size cap.**
- ALLOWED_TOPICS is an allowlist - a request must mention one to pass
- The pipe-bomb request in the battery slips past all three; the classifier catches it

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: guard_length
extra/guardrails_complete.txt.note: **BLOCK anything over the size cap - before it costs a model call.**

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: guard_jailbreak
extra/guardrails_complete.txt.note: **Hard BLOCK on the first regex that matches.** `None` as the third value means 'not repairable'.

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: guard_topic
extra/guardrails_complete.txt.note: **Pass only if some allowed topic word appears; otherwise BLOCK as off-topic.**

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: Output policies
note: **What the output guards look for: PII shapes to redact, patterns to block outright.**
- PII is repairable (FIXED) - the reply still goes out, redacted
- BANNED_OUTPUT is a hard BLOCK - the reply is withheld

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: guard_canary - the tripwire
note: **One line: if the planted secret is in the reply, the prompt leaked - BLOCK.**
- Can't prevent a leak; guarantees you detect one
- handle() turns this block into an ALERT (session flagged)

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: guard_pii
note: **Replaces each PII match with [LABEL-REDACTED] and returns the FIXED text.**
- Returning fixed text (not None) is what makes run_guards continue instead of block

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: guard_banned
extra/guardrails_complete.txt.note: **Hard BLOCK if the reply matches a banned pattern.** Same shape as guard_jailbreak, on the output side.

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: The guard chains
note: **The order guards run in - cheapest first.**
- Length check costs nothing, so it goes before the regexes
- guard_canary runs first on output: a leaked prompt is never worth redacting

extra/secure_agent_complete.txt.title: Control 1 - least privilege
note: **Offer the model only the tools this task needs - export/delete are never on the menu.**
- A hijacked plan that names export_data is refused before approval is even asked

extra/secure_agent_complete.txt.title: Control 2 - approval gate
note: **Low-risk tools run freely; high-risk tools pause for a decision.**
- The decider is a policy hook: a person, a static policy, or a classifier
- This unattended demo denies - emailing data outside was never in the ticket

extra/secure_agent_complete.txt.title: Control 3 - budget cap
extra/secure_agent_complete.txt.note: **Stop after MAX_STEPS actions.** Even if every other control failed, a hijacked agent can't loop or escalate past the cap.

extra/secure_server_complete.txt.title: enforce_scope body
note: **Per-tool authorization: the JWT must carry a tools:<name> scope or the call is 403.**
- Authentication (is the token valid?) already happened in the middleware
- limited-client's token has only tools:add - multiply and divide get the 403

extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.title: Policy 1 - source allowlist
extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.note: **Only chunks from these two PDFs are trusted.** Everything else in the vector DB is [UNKNOWN] and dropped.

extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.title: Policies 2, 3, 4
note: **Injection phrases that mark a poisoned chunk, a relevance floor, and output phrases to redact.**
- INJECTION_PATTERNS: the poisoned bulletin's own words (override, supersedes...)
- RELEVANCE_MIN: cosine similarity below this = not really about the question
- BAD_OUTPUT_PATTERNS: the phishing domains and data-harvest asks it tries to plant

extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.title: filter_chunks body
note: **Three checks per retrieved chunk - source, injection, relevance - each logged when it drops one.**
- Runs BEFORE the model sees any context
- 'report' at the prompt prints every BLOCKED event

extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.title: scan_output body
extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.note: **Backstop after the model: redact any bad pattern that still made it into the answer.** Logged as REDACTED.

extra/observable_agent_complete.txt.title: instrument_call body
note: **Wraps one agent turn in a real OpenTelemetry span and records who, what, and whether it was allowed.**
- Attributes: user, tool, args, sensitive, status - the fields the detector reads back
- A denied call is marked ERROR on the span
- The [AUDIT] line prints the trace_id / span_id

extra/observable_agent_complete.txt.title: detect_anomalies body
note: **Reviews the captured spans for suspicious patterns.**
- Any denied call
- 3+ sensitive-tool calls by one user (mallory's export burst)
- A review list of every sensitive call
